test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Six letters K, L, M, N, O and P are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown in the figure.

Find the letter on the face opposite to M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d744ecdec87f64f301d05e5da16c2aaf6a9786b0efaf719316774bf4b4dbe6e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As K is common on both the dices I and III, it is clear that M, O, N, and L are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. P will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e806b790be540518eca29ba3ece5548fef741cc0b590ea18a06df04bf45b0bd0.png] 

Opposite pairs:

M → N

O → L

K → P

So, the opposite side of "M" will be side "N".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
